text:
maya: Quick sync — where are we on the Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant joint retail connector pilot announcement?
sam: timeline wise we promised a coordinated marketplace listing + press note for the week of May 10. can we still hit that? :calendar:
liam: eng is ~80% through the connector QA matrix. outstanding: backpressure tests and multi-tenant perf on dedicated pools.
emily: marketing needs final blurbs and customer quote by EOD Tue to draft the announcement. can product confirm features & limitations?
maya: features: federated search via Qdrant vector index, Snowflake delta ingestion, Databricks streaming adapter. limitation: initial release only supports < 3TB tables and single-region routing. add that to the blurb.
jenna: SI partners (NorthStar / LakeOps) want a dry-run demo environment next week. they need sample creds and a replay dataset. who owns env provisioning?
liam: eng will spin up a sandbox on dedicated capacity. need a small manifest: connector config, sample delta file, and :one: test customer account. I can provision if infra gives the policy hash.
sam: infra, can you share the policy template? marketplace-bot: policy-template-v2 created at /marketplace/policies/policy-template-v2.yaml :package:
marketplace-bot: action required: upload marketplace SKU draft -> assigned to maya ; deadline 2026-05-07T17:00Z
maya: noted. I'll draft SKU and blurb. emily, can you align on the marketing assets?
emily: yes. I'll prepare one-pager, 30s demo clip, and the announcement draft. need high-res logo and supported-model list from partner legal.
jenna: SI ask: runbook for on-prem install + firewall ports. liam can you add basic steps and a troubleshooting checklist?
liam: adding runbook. will include firewall: 443 outbound, 8060 (gRPC) in tunnel mode, and KV cache persistence notes.
maya: question on embargo: partners request a 48-hour heads-up before public. do we have a canary list?
emily: PR plan: internal canary -> partners -> public. timeline: partners get preview Thu 00:00 PT, public Fri 08:00 PT.
sam: ops needs a rollback plan if connector causes high egress. put guardrails: rate limit by tenant, auto-fallback to cached responses. liam can ship a feature-flag for that.
liam: I'll add the feature-flag: MARKETPLACE_RATE_LIMIT and a fallback ⏳. pushing to branch marketplace/safety-guard.
maya: legal: export controls + data residency note — we've flagged US & EU only for pilot. add to listing.
jenna: logistics: schedule a partner dry-run Wed 9am PT. emily, can you run the demo script?
emily: yes, I'll do the run and capture clips. need a stable seed prompt and sample queries.
maya: outstanding action items: 1) maya — SKU + blurb (due 5/7) 2) emily — assets + demo script (due 5/6) 3) liam — runbook + rate-limit flag + sandbox (due 5/5) 4) sam — infra policy and rollout checklist (due 5/4) 5) jenna — SI dry-run scheduling + partner comms (due 5/6).
sam: I'll upload infra policy and the rollout checklist to the shared folder and tag everyone.
marketplace-bot: reminder: attach signed partner MSA to the listing before publishing or the SKU will be blocked.
maya: we've got one potential blocker — Snowflake legal asked for a short privacy addendum. jenna, can you chase legal?
jenna: on it. pinging Snowflake legal now.
liam: quick note: for the multi-tenant perf test, please attach a sample tenant manifest; 10 tenants with varied sequence length is ideal.
maya: good call. I'll assemble sample manifest and drop it in the sandbox folder.
emily: ok, pushing announcement draft this afternoon for review.
sam: +1. if anyone hits blockers on infra, flag in #eng-infra asap.
maya: thanks team — next check-in Tue 14:00 PT. I'll post an agenda. :thumbsup:
